verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs list retention as a core product-analytics insight type, and retention can also be run via MCP, so measuring retention over time is directly covered. Slicing retention by behavioral cohorts is not shown: cohorts appear only for feature-flag rollout targeting and as an API scope, and nothing documents applying them as a breakdown or filter on retention. Missing for 10: documentation of breaking down or filtering retention by behavioral cohorts, details of how retention is configured over time periods, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can measure retention over time and slice it by behavioral cohorts

citations.quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog, then save them to dashboards, share them, and get alerted when they move.
